title: Accessibility: Keyboard navigation
description:
Part of larger accessibility ticket #148. Implement full keyboard navigation support.

**Requirements:**
- Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard focusable
- Implement logical tab order
- Add visual focus indicators
- Support Enter and Space key activation
- Implement Escape key to close modals/dropdowns
- Handle arrow keys for menus, sliders, and carousels
- Add focus trapping for modals
- Return focus to trigger element when closing modals

**Implementation Steps:**
1. Add tabindex="0" to custom interactive elements
2. Check and fix tab order throughout the app
3. Add CSS focus-visible styles
4. Implement Escape key handlers for modals
5. Implement arrow key navigation for menus
6. Add focus trapping for modals
7. Test navigation using only keyboard

**Files:**
- All Vue components with interactive elements
- Global CSS for focus-visible styles

**Estimated Effort:** 3-4 hours
**Priority:** Medium
**Dependencies:** None

**Note**: This is sub-task 2 of ticket #148 (Accessibility - 12-16 hours total)
